categories.main_business_segments: Tianjin Jinrong Tianyu Precision Machinery Inc. primarily operates in three main segments: electrical precision metal parts for energy management and power distribution systems, automotive precision metal parts including chassis, shock absorption, safety, thermal management, air conditioning, seats, and lightweight components for both traditional and new energy vehicles, and new energy storage systems providing integrated solutions for communication base stations, residential, and commercial energy storage applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as precision mold development, stamping, sheet metal processing, aluminum alloy laminar casting, automated welding, riveting, and proprietary integrated forming production lines. It emphasizes lean production, digital transformation integrating ERP, MES, QMS, and WMS systems, flexible manufacturing, and global networked factory operations. Innovations include green energy management with SF6-free medium voltage switchgear and smart energy coordination systems for communication base stations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global electrical giants like Schneider Electric, Siemens, ABB, and automotive suppliers such as Sumitomo Riko, ZF, Benteler, and Joyson Safety Systems. The company serves industries including energy management, industrial automation, renewable energy (wind, solar, distributed energy), AI data centers, rail transit, traditional and new energy vehicles, and communication base stations. Major markets are China, Southeast Asia, India, North America, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with production bases in Tianjin, Zhejiang, Guangdong, and Hubei. It has established overseas subsidiaries and factories in Thailand, India, Mexico, Hungary, and Hong Kong to serve Southeast Asia, India, North America, and European markets. This global network supports local production and supply chain integration aligned with strategic customers' global footprints.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianjin Jinrong Tianyu operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of precision metal components and integrated energy storage systems. It acts as a key supplier to major OEMs and system integrators, providing critical parts and assemblies that are essential for downstream product manufacturing and system deployment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment to maintain technological leadership, focusing on integrated forming equipment technology, green energy solutions such as SF6-free switchgear, automotive lightweighting, and smart energy management systems for communication base stations. It emphasizes collaboration with strategic customers for co-development, digital and intelligent manufacturing upgrades, and expanding new energy storage product lines to support sustainable development and internationalization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of precision metal parts and integrated energy storage products to end customers, including OEMs and system integrators. The company operates an order-driven production model with strategic framework agreements and project-based contracts. Pricing is based on material costs plus processing fees, with adjustments for raw material price fluctuations. Sales are conducted via direct sales domestically and FOB export sales internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global and domestic suppliers in the precision metal parts and energy storage sectors. It holds a strong market position by serving leading global customers such as Schneider Electric, Siemens, ABB, and major automotive suppliers. Its competitive advantages stem from advanced manufacturing technologies, lean and digital production systems, and a global network aligned with customer localization strategies, positioning it as a key player in the precision components and new energy storage markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.84 billion, a 20.48% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 75.8 million, a 17.66% decrease due to increased R&D investment and goodwill impairment. The company’s assets totaled about RMB 2.2 billion, with a net asset value of RMB 1.2 billion. It has shown steady revenue growth driven by international expansion and new energy storage business development, despite short-term profit pressure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tianjin Jinrong Tianyu emphasizes high-quality, cost-effective precision metal components and integrated energy storage solutions tailored to customer needs. Its unique value lies in proprietary integrated forming equipment technology, advanced material science for lightweight and corrosion-resistant parts, and smart energy management systems that enhance efficiency and sustainability. The company’s global network and deep collaboration with leading customers enable rapid response, customization, and support for green and digital transformation initiatives.
